functional.feature_title: User Login and Navigation on Quotes to Scrape Login Page
functional.feature_description:
As a user,
  I want to be able to log in to the system with various credentials
  And navigate to different parts of the website from the login page
  So that I can access secure content and browse information.

background.text: I am on the "Quotes to Scrape" login page at "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login"

scenarios.title: Successful user login with valid credentials

steps.text: I enter "toscrape" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
I enter "password" into the "password" field with selector "input[name='password']"
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should be redirected to the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/" home page
I should see the "Logout" link
I should not see the "Login" link

scenarios.title: Failed user login with invalid or missing credentials

steps.text: I enter "<username>" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
I enter "<password>" into the "password" field with selector "input[name='password']"
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see the error message "Invalid username or password."
I should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page
I should see the "Login" link

scenarios.examples:
| username      | password      |
      | wronguser     | wrongpass     |
      | toscrape      | wrongpass     |
      | wronguser     | password      |
      |               | password      |  # Missing username
      | toscrape      |               |  # Missing password
      |               |               |  # Both missing

  @smoke @regression @navigation

scenarios.title: Navigate to Quotes Home Page from Login page

steps.text: I click the "Quotes to Scrape" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/']"
I should be redirected to the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/" home page
I should see the main header "Quotes to Scrape"

scenarios.title: Navigate to external GoodReads.com website

steps.text: I click the "GoodReads.com" link with selector "a[href='https://www.goodreads.com/quotes']"
a new tab should open with the URL "https://www.goodreads.com/quotes"
the current tab should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page

scenarios.title: Navigate to external Zyte website

steps.text: I click the "Zyte" link with selector "a.zyte"
a new tab should open with the URL "https://www.zyte.com/"
the current tab should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page

scenarios.title: Verify presence and visibility of key elements on the login page

steps.text: I should see the "username" input field with selector "#username"
I should see the "password" input field with selector "input[name='password']"
I should see the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see the "Quotes to Scrape" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/']"
I should see the "GoodReads.com" link with selector "a[href='https://www.goodreads.com/quotes']"
I should see the "Zyte" link with selector "a.zyte"
the page title should be "Login"
the current URL should be "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login"

functional.raw_content:
Feature: User Login and Navigation on Quotes to Scrape Login Page

  As a user,
  I want to be able to log in to the system with various credentials
  And navigate to different parts of the website from the login page
  So that I can access secure content and browse information.

  Background:
    Given I am on the "Quotes to Scrape" login page at "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login"
    And I see the "Login" form

  @smoke @critical @regression @happy-path
  Scenario: Successful user login with valid credentials
    When I enter "toscrape" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
    And I enter "password" into the "password" field with selector "input[name='password']"
    And I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
    Then I should be redirected to the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/" home page
    And I should see the "Logout" link
    And I should not see the "Login" link

  @negative @regression @login-form
  Scenario Outline: Failed user login with invalid or missing credentials
    When I enter "<username>" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
    And I enter "<password>" into the "password" field with selector "input[name='password']"
    And I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
    Then I should see the error message "Invalid username or password."
    And I should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page
    And I should see the "Login" link

    Examples:
      | username      | password      |
      | wronguser     | wrongpass     |
      | toscrape      | wrongpass     |
      | wronguser     | password      |
      |               | password      |  # Missing username
      | toscrape      |               |  # Missing password
      |               |               |  # Both missing

  @smoke @regression @navigation
  Scenario: Navigate to Quotes Home Page from Login page
    When I click the "Quotes to Scrape" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/']"
    Then I should be redirected to the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/" home page
    And I should see the main header "Quotes to Scrape"

  @regression @navigation @external-link
  Scenario: Navigate to external GoodReads.com website
    When I click the "GoodReads.com" link with selector "a[href='https://www.goodreads.com/quotes']"
    Then a new tab should open with the URL "https://www.goodreads.com/quotes"
    And the current tab should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page

  @regression @navigation @external-link
  Scenario: Navigate to external Zyte website
    When I click the "Zyte" link with selector "a.zyte"
    Then a new tab should open with the URL "https://www.zyte.com/"
    And the current tab should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page

  @regression @page-elements @ui-validation
  Scenario: Verify presence and visibility of key elements on the login page
    Then I should see the "username" input field with selector "#username"
    And I should see the "password" input field with selector "input[name='password']"
    And I should see the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
    And I should see the "Quotes to Scrape" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/']"
    And I should see the "GoodReads.com" link with selector "a[href='https://www.goodreads.com/quotes']"
    And I should see the "Zyte" link with selector "a.zyte"
    And the page title should be "Login"
    And the current URL should be "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login"
```

validation.feature_description:
As a user,
  I want to interact with the login form,
  So that I can log in securely and receive appropriate feedback for invalid inputs.

scenarios.title: Attempt login with an empty username

steps.text: I leave the username field empty
I enter "password123" into the "password" field
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see an error message indicating "No active account found with the given credentials." or similar
I should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page

scenarios.title: Attempt login with an empty password

steps.text: I enter "testuser" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
I leave the password field empty
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see an error message indicating "No active account found with the given credentials." or similar
I should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page

scenarios.title: Attempt login with both username and password fields empty

steps.text: I leave the username field empty
I leave the password field empty
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see an error message indicating "No active account found with the given credentials." or similar
I should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page

scenarios.title: Verify error message for invalid credentials

steps.text: I enter "<username>" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
I enter "<password>" into the "password" field
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see an error message with text "<expected_error_message>"

scenarios.examples:
| username       | password      | expected_error_message                        |
      | non_existent   | some_password | No active account found with the given credentials. |
      | testuser       | wrong_password | No active account found with the given credentials. |
      | another_user   | invalid_pass  | No active account found with the given credentials. |

  @validation @positive @successful_login

scenarios.title: Successful login with valid credentials

steps.text: I have a valid username "test" and password "test"
I enter "test" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
I enter "test" into the "password" field
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should be redirected to the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/" page
I should see a success message indicating "You are now logged in." or similar
I should see a "Logout" link

scenarios.title: Verify password length constraints (hypothetical)

steps.text: I enter "testuser" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
I enter "<password>" into the "password" field
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see an error message indicating "<expected_error_message>"

scenarios.examples:
| password | expected_error_message                        |
      | short    | Please enter a password between 6 and 20 characters. |
      | toolongpasswordforthisfieldtestinginvalidatingtheentry  | Please enter a password between 6 and 20 characters. |

  @validation @negative @password_complexity @pattern

scenarios.title: Verify password format constraints (hypothetical)

steps.text: I enter "testuser" into the "username" field with selector "#username"
I enter "<password>" into the "password" field
I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
I should see an error message indicating "<expected_error_message>"

scenarios.examples:
| password   | expected_error_message                                   |
      | nopassword | Password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character. |
      | 12345abc   | Password must contain at least one uppercase letter and one special character. |
      | Abcde!23   | No active account found with the given credentials. (This would be if it passes format but is still invalid) |

  @validation @navigation @external_link

scenarios.title: Verify GoodReads.com link opens in a new tab

steps.text: I click the "GoodReads.com" link with selector "a[href='https://www.goodreads.com/quotes']"
the "https://www.goodreads.com/quotes" URL should open in a new tab or window
I should remain on the "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login" page in the original tab

security.feature_description:
As a security tester
  I want to verify the robustness of the login functionality
  To ensure protection against common web vulnerabilities like injection and bypass attempts.

background.text: I observe the initial session ID

scenarios.title: Prevent SQL Injection via Username Field

steps.text: I enter "<username_payload>" into the "Username" field (input#username)
I enter "securePass123" into the "Password" field (input[type='password'])
I click the "Login" button (input.btn.btn-primary)
I should see an error message indicating "Invalid credentials" or "Login failed"
the page content should not show any database errors
I should not be logged in

scenarios.examples:
| username_payload           |
      | ' OR '1'='1                |
      | " OR "1"="1                |
      | ' OR 1=1 --                |
      | " OR 1=1 --                |
      | admin' --                  |
      | admin' #                   |
      | admin' OR 'a'='a          |
      | admin' AND '1'='1 --      |

  @sqli @vulnerability @negative

scenarios.title: Prevent SQL Injection via Password Field

steps.text: I enter "testuser" into the "Username" field (input#username)
I enter "<password_payload>" into the "Password" field (input[type='password'])
I click the "Login" button (input.btn.btn-primary)
I should see an error message indicating "Invalid credentials" or "Login failed"
the page content should not show any database errors
I should not be logged in

scenarios.examples:
| password_payload           |
      | ' OR '1'='1                |
      | " OR "1"="1                |
      | ' OR 1=1 --                |
      | " OR 1=1 --                |
      | password' OR '1'='1       |
      | password' #               |
      | password' AND '1'='1 --   |

  @xss @vulnerability @negative

scenarios.title: Prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via Username Field

steps.text: I enter "<username_payload>" into the "Username" field (input#username)
I enter "securePass123" into the "Password" field (input[type='password'])
I click the "Login" button (input.btn.btn-primary)
I should not see any script execution or pop-ups
the page content should be free of injected HTML or JavaScript elements
I should see an error message indicating "Invalid credentials" or "Login failed"
I should not be logged in

scenarios.title: Prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via Password Field

steps.text: I enter "testuser" into the "Username" field (input#username)
I enter "<password_payload>" into the "Password" field (input[type='password'])
I click the "Login" button (input.btn.btn-primary)
I should not see any script execution or pop-ups
the page content should be free of injected HTML or JavaScript elements
I should see an error message indicating "Invalid credentials" or "Login failed"
I should not be logged in

scenarios.title: Verify Brute-Force Protection via Multiple Failed Attempts

steps.text: I have a known valid username "gooduser" (assuming this exists for testing lockout)
I attempt to log in with "gooduser" and invalid password "wrongpass1" for 5 times
I attempt to log in with "gooduser" and invalid password "wrongpass2" for another 5 times
I should eventually see a "Too many failed login attempts" message or similar rate-limiting indication
I should not be able to log in with valid credentials immediately afterwards for a specified period

scenarios.title: Verify Session ID Changes After Successful Login

steps.text: I have valid credentials "test:test" (assuming these are default/valid credentials for quotes.toscrape.com)
I log in with "test" into the "Username" field (input#username) and "test" into the "Password" field (input[type='password'])
I click the "Login" button (input.btn.btn-primary)
I should be redirected to the "Quotes" page
the current session ID should be different from the initial session ID

scenarios.title: Verify Session ID Is Securely Generated Before Login

steps.text: the initial session ID should be non-guessable and complex (e.g., sufficient length, alphanumeric)
the session ID should not contain any predictable patterns or sensitive information

scenarios.title: Handle Invalid Characters in Username

steps.text: I enter "<username_input>" into the "Username" field (input#username)
I enter "securePass123" into the "Password" field (input[type='password'])
I click the "Login" button (input.btn.btn-primary)
I should see an error message indicating "Invalid username format" or "Login failed"
I should not be logged in

scenarios.title: Prevent Login with Common Default Credentials

steps.text: I attempt to log in with common default credentials
I should see an error message indicating "Invalid credentials" or "Login failed"
I should not be logged in

scenarios.title: Verify HTTPS Protocol for Login Page

steps.text: the current URL should start with "https://"
the browser should indicate a secure connection (e.g., padlock icon)
no mixed content warnings should be displayed

accessibility.raw_content:
Feature: Accessibility of Login Page

  As a user with accessibility needs
  I want to interact with the login page
  So that I can log in successfully and comfortably

  Background:
    Given I am on the "Login" page at "https://quotes.toscrape.com/login"
    And I have refreshed the page

  @keyboard-navigation @tab-order @focus-management
  Scenario: Keyboard navigation follows a logical tab order and focus is visible
    When I press the "Tab" key
    Then the "Username" input field with selector "#username" should be focused
    And the focused element should have a visible outline
    When I press the "Tab" key
    Then the "Password" input field with selector "input[name='password']" should be focused
    And the focused element should have a visible outline
    When I press the "Tab" key
    Then the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary" should be focused
    And the focused element should have a visible outline
    When I press the "Tab" key
    Then the "Quotes to Scrape" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/']" should be focused
    And the focused element should have a visible outline
    When I press the "Tab" key
    Then the "Login" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/login']" should be focused
    And the focused element should have a visible outline
    When I press the "Tab" key
    Then the "GoodReads.com" link with selector "a[href='https://www.goodreads.com/quotes']" should be focused
    And the focused element should have a visible outline
    When I press the "Tab" key
    Then the "Zyte" link with selector "a.zyte" should be focused
    And the focused element should have a visible outline

  @keyboard-navigation @tab-order @focus-management
  Scenario: Reverse keyboard navigation (Shift+Tab) follows a logical order
    Given I have navigated forward with Tab until the "Zyte" link with selector "a.zyte" is focused
    When I press the "Shift+Tab" key
    Then the "GoodReads.com" link with selector "a[href='https://www.goodreads.com/quotes']" should be focused
    When I press the "Shift+Tab" key
    Then the "Login" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/login']" should be focused
    When I press the "Shift+Tab" key
    Then the "Quotes to Scrape" link with selector "a[href='https://quotes.toscrape.com/']" should be focused
    When I press the "Shift+Tab" key
    Then the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary" should be focused
    When I press the "Shift+Tab" key
    Then the "Password" input field with selector "input[name='password']" should be focused
    When I press the "Shift+Tab" key
    Then the "Username" input field with selector "#username" should be focused

  @form-labels @screen-reader @label-association
  Scenario: Username input field is correctly associated with its label
    Then the label for the "Username" input field with selector "#username" should be associated correctly
    And the label text should be "Username"

  @form-labels @screen-reader @label-association
  Scenario: Password input field is correctly associated with its label
    Then the label for the "Password" input field with selector "input[name='password']" should be associated correctly
    And the label text should be "Password"

  @error-handling @screen-reader @error-announcement
  Scenario: Invalid login attempt displays and announces a clear error message
    When I enter "invalid_user" into the "Username" field with selector "#username"
    And I enter "invalid_pass" into the "Password" field with selector "input[name='password']"
    And I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
    Then I should see an error message "Invalid username/password."
    And the error message should be perceivable by screen readers

  @error-handling @screen-reader @error-announcement
  Scenario: Attempting to login with an empty username field displays the general error message
    When I enter "" into the "Username" field with selector "#username"
    And I enter "password123" into the "Password" field with selector "input[name='password']"
    And I click the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary"
    Then I should see an error message "Invalid username/password."
    And the error message should be perceivable by screen readers

  @focus-management @initial-focus
  Scenario: Initial focus is on the username input field upon page load
    Then the "Username" input field with selector "#username" should be focused

  @color-contrast @text-readability
  Scenario: Page title has sufficient color contrast
    Then the element with text "Login" and selector "h2" should have a color contrast ratio of at least "4.5:1"

  @color-contrast @text-readability
  Scenario: Username label has sufficient color contrast
    Then the label for the "Username" input field with selector "#username" should have a color contrast ratio of at least "4.5:1"

  @color-contrast @text-readability
  Scenario: Password label has sufficient color contrast
    Then the label for the "Password" input field with selector "input[name='password']" should have a color contrast ratio of at least "4.5:1"

  @color-contrast @button-contrast
  Scenario: Login button text has sufficient color contrast
    Then the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary" should have a color contrast ratio of at least "4.5:1"

  @aria-roles @form-structure @screen-reader
  Scenario: Login form is semantically structured and perceivable by assistive technologies
    Then the "Login" form with selector "form" should be a native HTML5 form element
    And the "Username" input field with selector "#username" should have an accessible name
    And the "Password" input field with selector "input[name='password']" should have an accessible name
    And the "Login" button with selector "input.btn.btn-primary" should have an accessible name
```

order_of_execution.description: Execute core functional tests first to ensure basic login and navigation work as expected. Follow with validation tests to verify input handling and error messages. This establishes a baseline of system stability.
After confirming basic functionality, perform security vulnerability tests. This ensures that the login page is robust against common attacks before deeper user interactions are considered.
Finally, conduct accessibility tests. These tests can be performed once the page is functionally stable and visually complete, ensuring it's usable by individuals with disabilities.

dependencies: All test categories depend on the 'Quotes to Scrape' login page (https://quotes.toscrape.com/login) being accessible and rendered correctly.
Functional and Validation tests are foundational; significant failures here should block execution of Security and Accessibility tests until resolved.

Security tests may require specific user roles or configurations (e.g., admin access for certain attack vectors, though less likely for a public login page) if the system under test had such complexities.

functional_validation_data.details: Incorrect username, incorrect password, incorrect username and password combinations.
Empty username, empty password, very long strings for both fields, strings with special characters.
Multiple rapid login attempts with invalid credentials to test lockout mechanisms (if applicable).

security_data.details: Common SQL injection strings, XSS payloads (e.g., `<script>alert('XSS')</script>`), command injection attempts.
Large lists of compromised credentials (for simulating credential stuffing attacks, ideally in a controlled environment).
Common password dictionaries for brute-force attacks.

accessibility_data.details: Accessibility testing primarily focuses on the DOM structure, semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, color contrast, and keyboard navigability rather than specific input data. The page content itself serves as the 'data'.

setup_requirements.test_environment: A dedicated QA/Staging environment identical to production in terms of configuration, dependencies (e.g., database, network), and deployed code. This minimizes environment-specific failures.
browser_device_matrix: Desktop Browsers: Latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari (on macOS).
Mobile Browsers: Latest versions of Chrome on Android, Safari on iOS (simulators or real devices).
Responsiveness: Test across various screen resolutions and orientations.
tools_frameworks: Automated UI Test Framework: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, or Cypress.
Programming Language: Python (for Behave/Cucumber integration), Java, JavaScript.
Security Testing Tools: OWASP ZAP (for DAST scans), Burp Suite (manual penetration testing), SQLMap (for SQL injection validation).
Accessibility Testing Tools: Axe-core (for automated checks), Lighthouse (for audits), manual screen reader testing (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver), keyboard navigation checks.
Test Data Management: A mechanism to manage and inject test data (e.g., CSV, JSON files, or a small test data generator).
setup_requirements.network_configuration: Stable internet connection to access the public `quotes.toscrape.com` site. No specific internal network configurations required beyond standard internet access.

risk_coverage.functional_risks: Users unable to log in, incorrect redirection after login, broken navigation links. High impact on user experience and core functionality.
risk_coverage.validation_risks: Incorrect error messages, allowing invalid data submission, poor user feedback, potential for backend errors due to malformed input. Medium impact on data integrity and user experience.
risk_coverage.security_risks: Unauthorized access, data breaches, account compromise, denial of service, reputation damage, legal repercussions. Highest impact on system integrity, user trust, and business continuity.
risk_coverage.accessibility_risks: Exclusion of users with disabilities, legal non-compliance (e.g., WCAG standards), poor user experience for a significant user segment, reputational damage. Medium-High impact on inclusivity and legal standing.

trigger_points: On every pull request/merge request to `develop` or `main` branches.
After every successful build deployment to the QA/Staging environment.
Nightly builds for a full regression suite run.
pipeline_steps: **Deploy Phase**: Deploy the application to the designated test environment.
- Run Functional & Validation Automated Tests (using Selenium/Playwright).
- Integrate Automated Security Scans (e.g., OWASP ZAP DAST scan on login page).
- Integrate Automated Accessibility Scans (e.g., Axe-core checks).
- Aggregate test results (e.g., allure reports, custom HTML reports).
- Publish reports to a central dashboard (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD dashboards).
- Send notifications (Slack, email) for test failures or critical issues.
**Artifacts**: Store test logs, screenshots of failures, and detailed test reports.
ci_cd_integration.rollback_strategy: Automated tests failing critical path functional or high-severity security tests should block deployment to higher environments (e.g., production) and trigger an immediate rollback or hotfix process.

estimated_time.total_automated_execution_time: 35-60 minutes for a complete automated suite run.
estimated_time.manual_verification_time: Additional 30-60 minutes for critical manual checks (e.g., screen reader testing, complex security scenario verification) post-automation.

test_script_maintenance: Adopt Page Object Model (POM) for UI tests to abstract page elements and make scripts robust to UI changes.
Use clear, descriptive naming conventions for tests and steps.
Regularly refactor and remove duplicate code.
Parameterize test data to easily update and extend test cases without modifying code.
maintenance_tips.test_data_maintenance: Maintain a robust test data management strategy. Periodically refresh test data to reflect current application state and cover new edge cases.
maintenance_tips.tool_dependency_updates: Keep automation frameworks, browser drivers, and security/accessibility tools updated to ensure compatibility with new browser versions and exploit latest features/fixes.
maintenance_tips.monitoring_reporting_feedback: Continuously monitor test results, analyze flaky tests, and identify root causes of failures. Establish a feedback loop between QA and development teams to quickly address issues.
maintenance_tips.documentation_version_control: Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for test strategies, test cases, and environment setup. Store all test assets under version control.
